CustomField.description: Current state of utility service at this meter. Values are exactly the four in FSD 5.10.4. Disconnected (Vacant) is distinct from Inactive because a disconnected vacant space still belongs to the register and still costs management a standing charge.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Disconnected (Vacant) means service is off while the space is empty. Transferred means the account moved to a tenant. Inactive means the meter is no longer part of the register at all.
CustomField.label: Service Status
